shortDescription: 8-week five-day full body hypertrophy plan where every session trains the whole body with a different muscle emphasis.
descriptionHtml:
8-week five-day full body hypertrophy plan where every session trains the whole body with a different muscle emphasis.

Structure: 8 weeks, 5 scheduled sessions per week, 35+ referenced exercise ids.

Weekly split: Chest Focus, Back Focus, Quad Focus, Posterior Chain Focus, and Delts & Arms Focus.

  • Goal: hypertrophy
  • Level: intermediate
  • Duration: 8 weeks
  • Tags: full body, 5 days per week, high frequency, and muscle focus
